meta.name: resemble-detect
meta.description: Deepfake detection and media safety — detect AI-generated audio, images, video, and text, trace synthesis sources, apply watermarks, verify speaker identity, and analyze media intelligence using Resemble AI

copy.tagline: 检测AI生成的音视频、图像和文本，验证媒体真实性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要识别AI合成内容并验证媒体来源真实性
copy.tagline_en: Detect AI-generated audio, video, images, and text to verify media authenticity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify AI-synthesized content and verify media source authenticity

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检测音频、图片、视频和文本是否为AI生成，识别合成来源，分析媒体内容（如说话人、情绪、转录），以及添加或检测水印。
howto.when: 当用户询问媒体是否AI生成、要求检测深度伪造、验证真实性、溯源合成来源、分析媒体信息或处理水印时触发。

say.text: 帮我检测这段音频是不是AI生成的。
say.note: Claude会提交音频进行深度伪造检测并返回结果。

say.text: 分析这张图片的内容和真实性。
say.note: Claude会调用智能分析接口，返回场景描述和真实性评估。
Claude会调用水印添加接口，返回带水印的视频链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can detect whether audio, images, video, and text are AI-generated, trace synthesis sources, analyze media content (e.g., speaker, emotion, transcription), and apply or detect watermarks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks if media is AI-generated, requests deepfake detection, authenticity verification, source tracing, media intelligence analysis, or watermark handling.

say_en.text: Check if this audio is AI-generated.
say_en.note: Claude will submit the audio for deepfake detection and return results.

say_en.text: Analyze this image's content and authenticity.
Apply a watermark to this video.
say_en.note: Claude will call the watermark apply API and return the watermarked video URL.
